result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position by eliminating liquidated damages and penalties. However, it goes beyond the playbook by making schedule relief Vendor’s sole remedy and excluding all “other charges,” potentially waiving non-liquidated contractual or actual-damages remedies. A narrower revision should remove only the liquidated-damages/penalty obligation. The drafting is otherwise clear and professional, though “reasonable, equitable extension” is somewhat subjective.
